visualReview.method: Manual review of contact sheets built from the exact saved public offer images; URL binding and checksums were independently retained.

findings.finding: The source cover contains prominent promotional text; clean exterior alternatives are present.
The saved gallery contains an AUTO-KLEIN services advertising panel.
The first two saved images are financing/services advertising panels.
Earlier sample has a financing advertisement as its cover.

Manual visual identity review is needed: photographs appear inconsistent with the declared model/generation. A single follow-up public VIP request retained the same ID, title and gallery; no substitute model was inferred.
Four of five saved frames show very similar dashboard views; exact checksums differ.
